assets.caption: The scene is a cozy apartment interior, captured in a realistic style, evoking a lived-in and comfortable atmosphere. The overall tone is homey and functional, showcasing everyday life within the space. A large window with white vertical blinds dominates the main wall, allowing diffused light to enter the room. To the right of the window, a wooden coat rack stands, holding several items of clothing, including a white t-shirt, a blue shirt, and a dark jacket. A brown door with horizontal slats is visible next to the coat rack, suggesting an exit or another room. In the kitchen area, light wood cabinets line the upper and lower walls, providing ample storage. A white refrigerator and a white stove with a pot on it are positioned on the left side of the kitchen. A dark gray countertop extends along the kitchen walls, holding a microwave, a sink with a faucet, and a black coffee maker. A black and gray patterned mat is placed on the light-colored wooden floor in front of the sink, adding a touch of design. The kitchen is compact and efficient, designed for practical use. The window with blinds is centrally located on the main wall. The coat rack is to the right of the window, and the brown door is immediately adjacent to the coat rack. The refrigerator and stove are against the left wall of the kitchen, while the countertop and sink are along the opposing wall. The cabinets are mounted above the countertop and appliances.
